title: 1. ASSESS the situation
items: Stay calm – breathe deeply before acting
Analyze the dangers: fire, smoke, collapse, gas, electricity
Protect yourself first before rescuing others
Identify emergency exits

title: 2. ALERT emergency services
items: Dial the appropriate number (15, 17, 18, 112)
Give: your name, exact address, nature of the problem
Specify the number and condition of victims, any specific dangers
Do not hang up first, follow instructions

title: 3. PROTECT the victims
items: Move victims to safety if possible
Mark the area to prevent further accidents
Turn off gas and electricity if you can do so safely
Keep bystanders away

title: 4. PROVIDE first aid with basic gestures
items: Check for consciousness and breathing
Place the victim in the recovery position if unconscious but breathing
Apply pressure to bleeding with a clean cloth
Perform CPR (chest compressions) if trained
Warm the victims with an emergency blanket

title: 5. WAIT for emergency services
items: Clear access for emergency vehicles
Signal your presence (light, whistle, flag)
Pass on information when help arrives
Follow their instructions
